title: Benchmarking the Legal Reasoning of LLMs in Arabic Islamic Inheritance Cases
base_benchmarks: QIAS 2025 (Question-and-Answer in Islamic Studies Assessment Shared Task)
findings: Proprietary models like GPT-03 (92.3% accuracy) and Gemini Flash 2.5 (91.5%) significantly outperformed open-source Arabic LLMs in Islamic inheritance reasoning. Fine-tuning improved GPT-4o's performance but degraded Gemini Flash 2.5's, suggesting model-specific sensitivities. An ensemble of GPT-03, Gemini Flash 2.5, and Gemini Pro 2.5 achieved a 92.7% accuracy on the final test set, demonstrating high capability but also highlighting that even the best models occasionally fail on complex inheritance scenarios.
